title: 修改图中的边权
summary: 连通无向图中部分边权为负一，可把它们改为一到二十亿的正整数；要求 source 到 destination 的最短距离恰为 target，返回任一方案或空。
insight: 先忽略未知边计算固定边最短路：若已小于 target 无法增大，若等于则把所有未知边设为极大值。否则按输入顺序把未知边逐条设为一并重跑 Dijkstra；最短路首次降到 target 以下或相等时，新启用边必在造成下降的路径上，把该边增加 target-distance 即精确补足，之后未知边设极大值。
pitfalls: 固定边已有更短路径时无解
未知边最小只能设为一
补差边之后其余未知边必须避免引入更短路
图是无向图且距离使用 long

solutions.title: 逐条启用未知边并用 Dijkstra 补差
solutions.idea: 利用最短距离随未知边从禁用到权一单调下降。
steps: fixedDistance<target 返回空；等于时标记 matched
否则先设为一并计算 distance
若 distance<=target，把当前边加 target-distance 并设 matched
结束后 matched 返回 edges，否则空

code.java: class Solution { private static final int LARGE=2_000_000_000;private long shortest(int n,int[][] edges,int source,int destination){List<int[]>[] graph=new ArrayList[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)graph[i]=new ArrayList<>();for(int[] edge:edges)if(edge[2]>=0){graph[edge[0]].add(new int[]{edge[1],edge[2]});graph[edge[1]].add(new int[]{edge[0],edge[2]});}long[] distance=new long[n];Arrays.fill(distance,Long.MAX_VALUE);distance[source]=0;PriorityQueue<long[]> queue=new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(state->state[0]));queue.add(new long[]{0,source});while(!queue.isEmpty()){long[] state=queue.poll();long cost=state[0];int node=(int)state[1];if(cost!=distance[node])continue;if(node==destination)return cost;for(int[] next:graph[node]){long candidate=cost+next[1];if(candidate<distance[next[0]]){distance[next[0]]=candidate;queue.add(new long[]{candidate,next[0]});}}}return Long.MAX_VALUE;}public int[][] modifiedGraphEdges(int n,int[][] edges,int source,int destination,int target){long fixed=shortest(n,edges,source,destination);if(fixed<target)return new int[0][0];boolean matched=fixed==target;for(int[] edge:edges)if(edge[2]==-1){if(matched)edge[2]=LARGE;else{edge[2]=1;long distance=shortest(n,edges,source,destination);if(distance<=target){edge[2]+=(int)(target-distance);matched=true;}}}return matched?edges:new int[0][0];} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private val large=2_000_000_000;private fun shortest(n:Int,edges:Array<IntArray>,source:Int,destination:Int):Long{val graph=Array(n){mutableListOf<IntArray>()};for(edge in edges)if(edge[2]>=0){graph[edge[0]].add(intArrayOf(edge[1],edge[2]));graph[edge[1]].add(intArrayOf(edge[0],edge[2]))};val distance=LongArray(n){Long.MAX_VALUE};distance[source]=0;val queue=java.util.PriorityQueue<LongArray>(compareBy<LongArray>{it[0]});queue.add(longArrayOf(0,source.toLong()));while(queue.isNotEmpty()){val state=queue.poll();val cost=state[0];val node=state[1].toInt();if(cost!=distance[node])continue;if(node==destination)return cost;for(next in graph[node]){val candidate=cost+next[1];if(candidate<distance[next[0]]){distance[next[0]]=candidate;queue.add(longArrayOf(candidate,next[0].toLong()))}}};return Long.MAX_VALUE}fun modifiedGraphEdges(n:Int,edges:Array<IntArray>,source:Int,destination:Int,target:Int):Array<IntArray>{val fixed=shortest(n,edges,source,destination);if(fixed<target)return emptyArray();var matched=fixed==target.toLong();for(edge in edges)if(edge[2]==-1){if(matched)edge[2]=large else{edge[2]=1;val distance=shortest(n,edges,source,destination);if(distance<=target){edge[2]+=(target-distance).toInt();matched=true}}};return if(matched)edges else emptyArray()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { const int LARGE=2'000'000'000;long long shortest(int n,vector<vector<int>>& edges,int source,int destination){vector<vector<pair<int,int>>> graph(n);for(auto& edge:edges)if(edge[2]>=0){graph[edge[0]].push_back({edge[1],edge[2]});graph[edge[1]].push_back({edge[0],edge[2]});}vector<long long> distance(n,LLONG_MAX);distance[source]=0;priority_queue<pair<long long,int>,vector<pair<long long,int>>,greater<pair<long long,int>>> queue;queue.push({0,source});while(!queue.empty()){auto [cost,node]=queue.top();queue.pop();if(cost!=distance[node])continue;if(node==destination)return cost;for(auto [next,weight]:graph[node])if(cost+weight<distance[next]){distance[next]=cost+weight;queue.push({distance[next],next});}}return LLONG_MAX;}public:vector<vector<int>> modifiedGraphEdges(int n,vector<vector<int>>& edges,int source,int destination,int target){long long fixed=shortest(n,edges,source,destination);if(fixed<target)return{};bool matched=fixed==target;for(auto& edge:edges)if(edge[2]==-1){if(matched)edge[2]=LARGE;else{edge[2]=1;long long distance=shortest(n,edges,source,destination);if(distance<=target){edge[2]+=target-distance;matched=true;}}}return matched?edges:vector<vector<int>>{};} };
